lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters are organized into roughly horizontal rows. Larger, more isolated centroids are located in the mid-flank region, transitioning to a higher density of smaller, more closely packed clusters in the anterior region posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated intensity are visible, particularly in the central flank, intersecting with horizontal rows of blobs to form a loose grid-like structural arrangement.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal linear feature is observed along the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance gradient with a light-reflecting upper edge and a shadowed lower boundary.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible portion of the first dorsal fin displays a low-density distribution of small, moderately high-luminance blobs across its surface silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A major morphological anomaly is present on the trailing edge of the primary visible pectoral fin, manifesting as a deep, irregular concave amputation or notch. Additional white depigmented scarring is visible at the distal tip of the same fin.
other_distinctive_markers: A highly concentrated cluster of micro-scale high-luminance points is localized along the leading edge of the pectoral fin.
